Senses.Explanation: Manjusri is the sword-bearing and assembly-acting figure whom Chan speakers place inside questions, inherited cases, and public commentary. Wanshan Shanshuang and Baizhang Huaihai invoke him directly; unnamed questioners ask about him; Yongming Yanshou and Dahui Zonggao discuss inherited Manjusri episodes. The figure is often the subject inside a containing turn, so mention does not make him that turn’s utterer.
